name: Garrett Han
identity: Flame-driven martial force and superhuman perception. Walls break, pavement craters and golden fire carries his attacks across the arena.
amplifications: Coat the selected move in golden flame, adding explosive striking force, burning contact and greater damage to terrain.
Read movement at awakened speed and adjust the selected move towards the developing opening.
skills: Flame erupts behind a flying side kick, propelling Garrett into a devastating impact that tears through cover and blasts apart the surrounding ground.
Burst approach · heavy impact · area destruction
A compact release of internal force and golden fire drives a straight punch through a wall, showering the space beyond with broken masonry.
Garrett spins through a rising ring of flame, chaining a sweeping kick into a second explosive impact as shattered concrete lifts around him.
Rotating attack · nearby targets · broken footing
A burst of flame launches Garrett faster than ordinary sight can follow, carrying his next impact across the arena and leaving a burning path.
Garrett reads the opening motion of an attack, slips through its line and returns a blindingly fast strike into the exposed guard.
He rises on a roaring flame burst and plunges down with a driving punch, detonating a golden impact through pavement and nearby cover.
Aerial entry · ground impact · area destruction
A blazing spinning kick sweeps through the engagement, hurling struck opponents and loose wreckage away in a rolling arc of fire.
Garrett tracks a momentary opening and releases a tightly focused golden blast through his strike, punching through the target's cover before the flame spreads.
Precision breach · concentrated damage · fire spread
form_note: Golden Flame Transcendence strengthens these same skills and their environmental impact. Their base versions remain available without activating the form.

name: Rei Takamura
trait: Flowing Tempest · green lightning / wind / kinetic flow
identity: Continuous movement becomes extraordinary speed and force. Green lightning, wind and kinetic redirection give Rei three distinct ways to shape an exchange.
amplifications: Thread the selected move with green lightning, adding a sudden impact burst and disruptive electrical pressure.
Wrap the move in driving wind, increasing reach, displacement and the force carried into surrounding cover.
Carry accumulated movement into the move or redirect received force into its return; sustained motion increases speed and impact.
skills: Rei launches high above the arena and descends with a lightning-enhanced axe kick, blasting a crater into the ground and breaking nearby concrete.
Rei turns an incoming attack's force back towards its source, bending the exchange into a violent returning impact. It can answer melee, projectiles and ranged Trait attacks.
Universal attack-type counter · force return · clash resolution
He accelerates around the arena until his movements become a green blur, then releases the accumulated force through a spinning kick that blasts apart the impact area.
Movement buildup · extreme speed · devastating release
A sweeping kick launches a compressed green wind arc that cuts across the arena, ripping through concrete cover and vehicle panels.
Rei captures momentum through a throwing entry and drives the opponent into a spiralling wind-assisted crash capable of crushing a parked car.
Rei crosses the engagement in a straight flash of green sparks and delivers a concentrated, lightning-charged strike before ordinary eyes can follow.
A moving envelope of wind and redirected force surrounds his guard, scattering debris and carrying defended pressure into his next attack.
Rei becomes the centre of a local wind-and-lightning surge, dragging loose wreckage into motion before releasing it outward with a sweeping attack.
Local area control · debris movement · multi-angle pressure
form_note: Flowing Stream has no attack-type exclusion or stat unlock gate. Its return, partial redirection or failure is resolved against the incoming attack's force and Rei's timing; the narrator reports that result.

name: Ivan Yeun
identity: Fire, wind, ice, red lightning and blue lightning turn the same martial move into very different attacks. Elemental force can reshape the arena.
amplifications: Engulf the move in flame, adding explosive contact and igniting breakable cover or ground surfaces.
Drive the movement with a forceful gust, extending its reach and throwing targets or wreckage farther.
Armour the striking surface with ice and spread freezing material at impact, altering grip and footing.
Guard pressure · chilled footing · temporary cover
Concentrate red electrical force through the move for a heavier, more disruptive impact.
Run blue electrical force through the movement for rapid acceleration and sharper reaction timing.
skills: Ivan drives a roaring, fire-coated knee into the engagement; its impact bursts through cover and leaves a scorched crater beneath the collision.
Ice builds around his shoulder as he charges, smashing a barrier into a cloud of frozen shards and leaving broken, slippery terrain behind him.
Armoured charge · barrier break · icy terrain
A turning kick releases a compressed wind blade across the arena, shearing vehicle panels and splitting exposed cover along its path.
Ranged slash · line damage · cover cutting
Ivan concentrates red lightning into a strike that erupts on contact, throwing the target back through nearby cover.
A blue flash marks Ivan's explosive movement across a short stretch of the arena, followed by a strike delivered faster than ordinary perception.
Ice surges across a chosen patch of ground and rises around the opponent's path, contesting their movement and creating a breakable obstruction.
Terrain control · movement restraint · destructible ice
A gust throws Ivan upward before he crashes down inside a red-lightning impact that fractures the landing zone.
Aerial entry · electrical burst · ground destruction
Ivan spins a ring of ice and driving wind around the engagement, shredding fragile cover and forcing the opponent to cross hazardous footing.
Local area pressure · ice fragments · altered footing
Blue lightning carries him around the guard in a blur; red lightning erupts through the finishing blow and drives the target into the scenery.
A rapid sequence of flame, wind, ice and both lightning channels culminates in an arena-shaking impact that tears through clustered cover.
Multi-element sequence · high resource demand · area destruction
form_note: All five channels and these base skills are available through Conduit. Conduit State remains a separate five-minute form with its existing daily activation cooldown. Red/blue mechanical identities above are proposed distinctions for review.

name: Sylvanis
identity: Physical shadow constructs, superhuman perception and accelerated analysis let Sylvanis overwhelm both terrain and an opponent's defensive choices.
amplifications: Extend or reinforce the selected move with shaped shadow, increasing contact force, reach and pressure against cover.
Read the immediate movement of a fast opponent and adjust the move's timing and line in response.
Exploit observed habits and martial structure to select an unexpected angle or punish a repeated defence.
skills: A massive shadow fist follows Sylvanis's strike, crushing a wall or vehicle beneath the combined impact.
Thick bands of shadow close around an opponent or a piece of cover, contesting escape while exerting crushing force.
Shadow obscures his approach as he accelerates beyond ordinary perception and drives a shadow-reinforced strike through the engagement.
Sylvanis tracks the first change in an attack's movement and launches a blindingly fast counter along the exposed line.
He recognises a repeated defensive structure and switches martial rhythm mid-combination, concentrating awakened force into its weakest opening.
Several shaped shadows converge from different angles while Sylvanis drives the opponent towards a collapsing pocket of cover.
Multi-angle attack · position pressure · breakable cover
A dense mass of shadow crashes down over a chosen area, crushing concrete and hurling loose wreckage away from the impact.
Area impact · overhead pressure · debris movement
Sylvanis reads the opponent's escape, cuts it off with shadow constructs and delivers a rapid finishing sequence that tears apart the surrounding arena.
form_note: The skills themselves remain selectable without a stat gate. Active second-stage Transcendence upgrades their shadow effects with corrosive, burning, explosive or piercing properties and operation in absolute light; those upgrades are form state, not new base skills.

name: Charles Han
identity: White flame gives Charles's precise martial pressure the impact and presence of a charging tiger.
amplifications: Reinforce the move with concentrated white flame for searing contact and heavy structural damage.
Focus the same white-flame reinforcement into explosive forward motion and forceful close pressure.
Wrap a defensive move in white flame that contests incoming contact and burns nearby debris.
skills: Charles launches in a white-flame burst and crashes into his opponent with a striking pounce that smashes nearby concrete.
A focused white-flame punch drives through a guarded opening and blows a jagged breach through the cover behind it.
A sweeping turn releases a ring of white-flame strikes, flinging loose debris away from the close engagement.
A forceful release of flame rolls outward from his martial strike, blasting apart obstacles along its short path.
Charles turns a defended opening into two explosive white-flame blows, each pressing a different line of the guard.
White flame reinforces his frame as he advances through flying wreckage and delivers a close-range returning strike.
form_note: His earned Transcendence intensifies the tiger manifestation, flame output and physical reinforcement; the base moves have no martial or refinement threshold.

name: Takeo Mishima
identity: Internal nanomachines turn Takeo into a living siege weapon: armour, transformed striking surfaces and immense reinforced force.
amplifications: Concentrate nanomachine support behind a regular move to increase force and collision damage.
Redistribute reinforcement around the selected defence, increasing resistance to the incoming strike.
Reshape the move's striking surface into an established adaptive weapon form.
skills: Nanomachines reinforce Takeo's arm into a battering weapon; his punch ploughs through concrete and sends the broken wall outward.
He drives forward behind concentrated armour, crushing a vehicle or barrier beneath a devastating shoulder charge.
Armour thickens and shifts across his body to meet the incoming force, letting him contest a heavy attack without surrendering his stance.
An adaptive arm weapon extends into a sweeping strike that cleaves through the engagement and tears into structural cover.
A surge of internal reinforcement drives his massive body faster than ordinary sight, culminating in a crushing close-range attack.
Takeo launches and descends under heavy reinforcement, smashing the landing zone into a crater and scattering wreckage.
form_note: Nanoengine manipulates his own nanomachines and body. The catalogue does not grant remote control of cars, electronics or other people's bodies.

name: The Crow
identity: Superhuman analysis directs an already formidable awakened body and a vast learned martial repertoire.
amplifications: Use observed defensive habits to improve the selected move's timing and accuracy.
Choose a compatible transition from arts he actually knows to pressure the opponent's current response.
Concentrate the move on an observed weakness in a guard or physical obstacle.
skills: The Crow chains learned techniques around observed escape routes, his awakened blows driving the opponent through collapsing cover.
Accelerated analysis identifies a returning line and sends a precisely timed, superhuman strike into the exchange.
He reads the structure of a guard or barrier and commits a concentrated strike that can punch a clean breach through concrete.
A rapid, finite sequence shifts between his learned arts, changing range and rhythm faster than an ordinary fighter can process.
The Crow presents an enticing opening, reads the commitment and turns it into a devastating returning combination.
He moves through predicted attack lines in a blur, finding a position from which to launch his next precise strike.
form_note: The physical speed and destruction come from his awakened body. Polymath directs them through observation and analysis; it does not copy someone else's Trait.

name: Martos Cabrera
identity: Battle pressure magnifies his strength, durability and physical mutation until the arena itself gives way beneath him.
amplifications: Drive the regular move with escalating strength as battle pressure rises.
Reinforce a defensive action with increased physical durability.
Concentrate mutation into the move for greater reach and force, trading away fine control.
skills: Martos surges through the engagement with terrifying speed for his size, flattening a car or concrete barrier in his path.
A heavily reinforced downward strike pulverises the impact point and sends fragments of concrete across the nearby arena.
He catches a close opponent or a piece of cover in an immense grip, contesting escape before crushing or hurling it aside.
A violent stamp fractures the ground, disrupting footing and lifting loose rubble into the surrounding engagement.
Martos pushes his mutation into a short, brutal offensive burst, gaining enormous impact at the expense of precise movement.
He braces through an incoming collision and returns the accumulated battle pressure with a strike that sends the opponent into surrounding cover.
form_note: Rage can be used at any Trait-capable stat level. Greater pressure changes its output and control; it does not erase incoming damage.

name: Elias Braun
identity: Motion becomes heat. His movement builds an increasingly destructive reservoir that he releases through strikes and burning trails.
amplifications: Release accumulated movement heat through the selected attack.
Generate heat while moving through the action and leave a hot trail along the travelled route.
Carry heat through a combo's continuation to pressure an opponent who remains close.
skills: Elias accelerates through a series of rapid steps, gathering heat until the ground behind him glows and his movements blur.
Movement buildup · extreme speed · heat reserve
A fast rotating kick releases accumulated heat in a blazing arc, battering the opponent and scorching surrounding cover.
He drives along a heated movement line and unloads it through a straight strike, blasting a fiery breach through concrete.
Successive kicks build and release heat in rhythm, making the later impacts fiercer as the sequence continues.
Elias circles the engagement at superhuman speed, laying intersecting heated trails that change the opponent's safe routes.
He takes accumulated heat airborne and drives it down through a finishing kick that bursts the landing surface apart.
form_note: Skills remain selectable with an empty heat reserve: movement stages build heat, while immediate releases are weaker until heat has accumulated.

name: Mavis Kuro
identity: Dark-vapour dispersal lets Mavis evade physical lines, move through gaps and return with the impact of an awakened body.
amplifications: Cover the regular move in dark vapour to obscure its line and timing.
Partially disperse during a defensive movement to contest contact along the incoming line.
Concentrate the return to physical form into the move's striking beat.
skills: Mavis breaks into dark vapour as an attack arrives, slides off its line and reforms at a new angle.
The struck silhouette disperses into a cloud while Mavis reforms beside the attack line and returns a superhuman close strike.
A hand reforms from obscuring mist into an explosive palm strike capable of caving in a vehicle panel or breaking masonry.
Dark vapour floods the lower engagement as she moves in a blur and sweeps through the opponent's footing.
She disperses through an available opening in broken cover and reforms beyond it, turning arena damage into a new movement route.
A broad curtain of dark mist rolls across part of the arena, interrupting sight lines and concealing a rapid change of position.
form_note: Dispersal uses Mist's established body transformation. Bright light, mana and actual available gaps still affect it; no additional teleportation power is introduced.

name: Camila Lopez
identity: Accelerated perception of patterns directs her awakened movement and Aikido into exact reversals and structural breaks.
amplifications: Read an observed attack line and adjust the regular move's response.
Use repeated behaviour to improve the next attack or defensive choice.
Concentrate force on a visible weakness in a guard, grip or arena object.
skills: Camila identifies a structural weakness and delivers an awakened palm strike that fractures the barrier along it.
Her accelerated analysis follows a repeated defensive habit, setting up a precisely timed strike along its recurring opening.
She reads a committed entry and turns it into an explosive Aikido reversal, sending the opponent into nearby cover.
Camila recognises the instant an opponent commits their weight and moves at awakened speed to seize the next exchange.
A calculated opening draws a response that she analyses in motion before returning a forceful, precisely placed strike.
Rapid changes of grip and direction turn successive defensive reactions into a powerful throwing finish through the scenery.
form_note: Analysis operates at superhuman speed but uses observed information. Destructive force is supplied by Camila's awakened body, not an invented energy projection.

name: Samantha Kim
identity: Accessible blood becomes striking edges, projectiles, restraints and barriers with force far beyond an ordinary weapon.
amplifications: Shape accessible blood around the regular move into a reinforced cutting or striking surface.
Extend the action with a controllable blood strand that contests movement or pulls on a contacted object.
Gather accessible blood into a temporary protective layer around a defensive action.
skills: A dense lance of blood shoots across the arena with enough force to burst masonry and pin broken cover against the impact surface.
Blood strands whip around the opponent from outside their body, contesting movement and dragging loose objects into their path.
A broad, hardened blood arc sweeps through the engagement and slices into vehicle panels or exposed cover.
A controlled mass of accessible blood erupts into a short-range array of striking forms, hammering the nearby guard and scenery.
Blood plates gather into a breakable shield that meets the incoming impact and scatters under sufficient force.
A shaped blood weapon curves back across the arena under her control, threatening a second angle after its initial pass.
form_note: Mana and accessible blood determine scale. Supplying her own blood has a real health cost; these skills do not control blood inside an intact opponent.

name: Tyler Harding
identity: Absorbed impact becomes a reserve that Tyler releases through devastating boxing strikes, sending force back into opponents and terrain.
amplifications: Add available stored impact to the selected punch or combo.
Use a defensive action to store part of a received impact while still suffering its resolved damage.
Concentrate available impact into a narrower contact instead of spreading it through the combo.
skills: Tyler unloads stored force through a straight punch that drives an opponent through a wall or crushes the vehicle behind them.
He braces into an attack and returns its collected force through an explosive punch during the same contested exchange.
A tightly braced defence captures part of a heavy collision, converting the surviving pressure into a reserve for his next strike.
A loaded hook releases a sweeping collision that throws the opponent and nearby wreckage across the engagement.
Tyler divides his reserve across a rapid boxing barrage, each punch delivering a distinct burst of stored force.
Stored impact erupts through a rising punch, launching the struck target into a heavy landing that damages the arena.
form_note: Release skills always remain selectable. With no stored impact they use Tyler's base awakened striking force; stronger discharges consume the actual reserve.

name: Minsu Park
identity: Explosive acceleration, movement faster than normal perception and sharply accelerated reactions amplify his Taekwondo.
amplifications: Drive the regular move into striking range before ordinary perception can track the approach.
Accelerate reaction timing during the selected defence or counter.
Carry movement speed into the selected impact for greater force and knockback.
skills: Minsu closes in a sudden blur and releases a kick that strikes before an ordinary observer sees him arrive.
Rapid angle changes create apparent after-images while he moves around the incoming attack and seeks a new opening.
A finite chain of kicks arrives in a blur, changing level between impacts faster than normal vision can separate them.
Minsu accelerates across the opponent's attack line and delivers a stopping kick at the point of interception.
He builds speed across the arena and converts it into a driving kick that launches the opponent into a barrier or parked car.
Successive short bursts circle the guard before a final kick lands along the rapidly changing attack line.
form_note: The apparent disappearance and after-images are literal superhuman movement effects. He still travels through the arena; this does not add a teleportation Trait.

name: Valentina Yeun
identity: Cutting wind, concentrated pressure and powerful gusts turn her acrobatic movement into an arena-shaping threat.
amplifications: Extend the regular move with a concentrated cutting gust.
Use wind to accelerate the move, lift a leap or drive a struck target away.
Wrap a defensive movement in opposing wind to contest contact and deflect loose debris.
skills: A powerful cutting gust falls across the engagement, slicing into cover and tearing through vehicle bodywork.
A rising gust throws Valentina into an extraordinary leap before she returns with a wind-driven acrobatic kick.
Converging gusts compress the space around the opponent, contesting movement and crushing fragile cover caught between them.
Zone pressure · restraint contest · cover damage
A sweeping attack sends a long, compressed wind crescent through the arena and splits obstacles along its line.
She drives a counter-gust into incoming physical force, diverting the collision and returning an attack along the new opening.
A finite succession of violent gusts strikes from changing directions, scattering wreckage and forcing repeated defensive adjustments.
form_note: Deathwind controls actual wind and pressure. Its destructive name does not create automatic death or a separate soul power.

name: Emily Fields
identity: Created weak points let her awakened strikes produce extraordinary breaks; pain suppression supports commitment without preventing injury.
amplifications: Use the move to establish a vulnerable point on an opponent or breakable arena object.
Direct the move into an established weak point for amplified damage and structural failure.
Suppress pain interference during the action while retaining all resolved health loss.
skills: Emily creates a vulnerable point on the chosen target, setting up a future impact capable of breaking far stronger material than the initial touch.
A precise awakened strike exploits a weak point and breaks a wall, barrier or vehicle panel around the contact.
Emily bursts towards the target at awakened speed and drives a strike through a newly exposed weakness in its defence.
She suppresses pain long enough to continue a committed offensive movement through a damaging exchange.
Commitment · pain suppression · damage still applies
Successive contacts establish and exploit a short sequence of weak points, turning a compact combination into a destructive cascade.
Emily concentrates an attack into an established weak point, consuming the opening in one heavy impact that can collapse the surrounding cover.
form_note: This follows the game's existing peak-combat version of Emily, where Critical Hit is available. Pain immunity never removes damage or knockout.

name: Alyssa
identity: Shaped shadows become substantial striking forms, screens and restraints. Her shadow attacks are fully superhuman without inheriting Sylvanis's other powers.
amplifications: Shape shadow around the regular move to increase force, contact size and pressure against cover.
Use shifting shadow to conceal the move's line and direction.
Extend a move with a shaped shadow strand that contests a target's position.
skills: A shaped shadow mass follows Alyssa's strike and smashes into the target with enough force to break concrete cover.
Long ribbons of shadow wrap around the outside of a target or object, contesting movement and pulling against its position.
A layered shield of shadow meets an incoming attack, breaking or holding according to the force of the clash.
Shadow conceals a burst of awakened movement as Alyssa changes angle and returns with a reinforced strike.
A broad shadow sweep travels through the lower engagement, disrupting footing and throwing loose obstacles aside.
Wide control · balance attack · debris displacement
A heavy shadow form descends onto a chosen patch of the arena, crushing cover beneath a forceful overhead impact.
form_note: Alyssa keeps shadow manipulation and her own heightened physical abilities. True Sight, Polymath and Sylvanis's second-stage special shadow properties remain his abilities.

name: Edward Fox
identity: Superhuman sensory processing tracks combat through darkness, sound, vibration and air movement, guiding forceful awakened CQC.
amplifications: Track physical cues during the move to improve accuracy against concealed or rapidly moving targets.
Use approaching physical cues to sharpen the selected defence or counter.
Read vibrations through contact to focus a strike on an object's structural weakness.
skills: Fox tracks an attacker outside ordinary sight through physical cues and returns a sharply timed awakened strike.
He follows movement, heartbeat and displacement through visual obstruction, advancing at superhuman speed along the detected line.
Fox chooses a low-noise route through the arena and closes in a sudden burst, using sensory feedback to time a forceful entry.
Surface vibration and air displacement reveal an incoming attack's approach, letting Fox change line and launch a returning strike.
Multiple streams of sensory information converge on a fast-moving target as he launches a precise interception through the exchange.
Fox reads a contacted barrier's vibration and drives an awakened strike into its weak structure, bursting a route through the masonry.
form_note: Eight Senses supplies physical information, not mind-reading. Fox's awakened body provides the speed and destructive force of the resulting action.

name: Jeremy Gordon
identity: Grown biological weapons and adaptive components provide real, finite firepower capable of destroying vehicles and breaching concrete.
amplifications: Grow a supporting component around the selected regular move for stronger contact and guard pressure.
Integrate a grown handgun or rifle component into the action's follow-through.
Grow a protective or stabilising component around the chosen defensive movement.
skills: A heavy biological firing construct releases a concentrated round that punches through concrete or tears into a vehicle's structure.
Several grown firing channels deliver a finite burst across different angles, hammering the guard and exposed cover.
Gordon forms a specialised high-impact component and fires a shot shaped to break the selected obstacle.
Adaptive biological components grow into a breakable shield around his defensive line, taking the brunt of an incoming collision.
He replaces damaged or spent firing components and brings a fresh biological weapon into action during a controlled reset.
A rifle-like growth concentrates its output into a powerful linear shot that breaches a barrier and threatens the space immediately beyond.
form_note: The added component expressions are proposed extensions of his established biological weapons. They cost mana and do not add external ammunition or general body-healing powers.

name: Neo Ishida
identity: Awakened physical ability, elite reactions and peak combat processing. These are proposed signature actions, separate from Trait amplification and Trait unique skills.
skills: Neo crosses the engagement faster than ordinary perception and delivers a precise CQC strike along the new line.
A fully committed close strike drives his awakened strength through the target's cover, breaking concrete at the collision.
His accelerated processing tracks a changing attack and selects a learned CQC response during the exchange.
form_note: No Nanoengine, Polymath or new Trait is assigned. Martial tier requirements continue to apply to ordinary learned martial moves.

name: Daniel Stevens
identity: Developed awakened strength and instinctive battle aptitude. His signature actions remain physical rather than fabricated elemental powers.
skills: Daniel shifts from learned striking into a takedown in a blurring sequence, driving the resulting collision through nearby cover.
He commits his awakened strength to a heavy close strike or throw that shatters the impact surface.
Daniel reads the physical pressure of a contested exchange and reverses it into a fast, forceful counter.
form_note: These are separately labelled signature-action suggestions. Trait amplification and the custom Trait workshop stay unavailable until an actual Trait is established.

name: April Xu
identity: Superhuman cognition is her distinction. These signature suggestions express accelerated analysis without silently giving her another character's named Trait or martial mastery.
skills: April processes the observed exchange at extraordinary speed and chooses a defensive line from the information available.
Repeated movements become a rapid internal map of likely attack routes and recoveries, helping her contest the next exchange.
She identifies a developing gap and uses her existing awakened movement to reach it before the pressure closes.
form_note: Her existing lower martial rating still affects execution. No stat is a lock on her established cognition; no rare Trait or automatic superhuman fighting expertise is invented.

name: Number Thirteen
identity: Shinigami conditioning and specialised martial training support superhuman physical suppression and interception.
skills: Thirteen crosses the gap in a blur and delivers a tightly linked physical sequence that pressures the opponent into breaking cover.
A braced interception turns a heavy collision into a powerful returning strike or takedown.
An abrupt burst of speed carries Thirteen across an expected attack line and into close striking range.
form_note: Physical suppression disrupts actions and positioning. It does not grant automatic cancellation of Traits or mana.

name: Keisuke Hachimura
identity: Awakened physical power supports his Kyokushin and Japanese Jujutsu. No elemental or rare Trait is added.
skills: A conditioned close strike delivers enough awakened force to smash concrete when the opponent is driven into it.
A secure throwing entry turns exceptional strength into a landing that cracks the ground beneath the impact.
Keisuke maintains a rapid sequence of learned body strikes, kicks and control transitions, forcing repeated defensive responses.
form_note: These physical signature suggestions remain separate from Trait systems. His learned martial catalogue still follows the agreed martial training rules.

name: Yuriko Takamura
identity: No current Trait amplification or Trait unique skills. Ordinary martial training and universal defensive actions remain available.
form_note: Awakening alone does not automatically invent a rare Trait. A future authored Trait would need its own reviewed amplification options and unique skills.
